overview_description.description: BwaTech is a company that provides a platform for account and finance management. It enables corporates dealing with multiple banks to conduct banking operations through a single platform. The company is recognized by the Saudi Central Bank to test its innovative services under the Regulatory Sandbox environment. BwaTech also offers a free application, BWAKey, intended for user convenience. The company is involved in the banking, finance, and fintech industries.

product.name: BwaKey
product.description: A two-factor authentication mobile app that enhances account security by protecting against unauthorized access and data breaches.
